findings.passage: This law violates the inalienable right of all Oregonians to defend themselves and their families. Disarming law-abiding citizens is inviting violence into our communities and our homes. Gun-free zones are invitations to mass shootings and attacking law-abiding Oregonians isn’t going to make anyone safer. In fact, it will put us in danger. I will not compromise on the Second Amendment.
findings.note: Constituent newsletter signed by the District 28 senator, sent the day before a Senate Judiciary hearing on SB 978 (2019). Opposes the bill's amendment, which he says would bar concealed carry in practice, and opposes gun-free zones.

findings.passage: In this case, the forty-four-page amendment to SB 978 is an full-scale barrage against the Second Amendment including a backdoor ban on concealed carry.
findings.note: Same newsletter. Describes the SB 978 amendment as an attack on gun rights and urges readers to contact lawmakers to stop it; the bill covers possession, storage, buying and selling of firearms.
